editorialFindings.sharedPhraseDisposition: Listed overlap, if any, consists of ordinary subject-specific phrases, inspected in the complete sentences rather than treated as a numerical quota.
editorialFindings.substantiveReview: The pro synthesis conditions mediated revelation on moral constraints, reliable formation, positive support and responsible correction. Its new arguments distinguish convergent transformative conduct from proof and make self-correction accountable to a public hierarchy of reasons. The con synthesis develops a probabilistic expectation about competent benevolent communication, then adds asymmetric harm costs and cross-tradition calibration. Each reinforcement supplies an inference and limiting condition. The ten premises are distinct complete steps, and clauses, lists, contrasts and qualifications retain ordinary punctuation.
